title: Request without a session is rejected
Forged / tampered session token is rejected
request: GET /api/client/me with the client token's payload edited to role SYSTEM_ADMIN

title: Development identity headers are ignored outside development
request: GET /api/staff/accounts with x-user-id / x-user-role: SYSTEM_ADMIN headers and no token

title: Self-registration cannot create a staff account
Registering an existing email is refused
actual: 409 "An account with this email already exists."

title: Specialist cannot list or create staff accounts
Owner cannot change another owner's property
Branch staff cannot widen scope with ?branch=
Branch staff cannot approve another branch's registration
request: POST /api/staff/queue/property/<id>/approve as the Malé specialist for a pending Villingili unit (Villingili Shore 3A)

title: Unapproved listing is not visible publicly
Client cannot read every application in the system
expected: 403, or only the client's own applications
actual: 200 – returned 8 applications, 7 belonging to other users (with their full user records, e.g. email mariyam.saeed@housing-4-raajje.test).

title: Client cannot read every maintenance request and lease
request: GET /api/maintenance and GET /api/leases with a CLIENT token
expected: 403, or only the client's own records
actual: maintenance 200: 0 other tenants' requests; leases 200: 5 other tenants' leases (rent, deposit, client record).

title: Client cannot sign a lease that is not theirs
request: PATCH /api/leases/cmw7wlo9k007p1a1esinyyx9q/sign (LSE-2026-0107, another tenant) with a CLIENT token
actual: 200 – lease was ACTIVE; response clientSigned=true, status=ACTIVE. The API accepted a signature from a client who is not party to the lease.

title: Client cannot record a payment on someone else's lease
request: POST /api/payments { leaseId: LSE-2026-0107, status: "PAID", amount: 1 } with a CLIENT token (preview)
actual: 201 – created payment cmw7wplur00050c1esc39ltn8 status=PAID amount=1 on LSE-2026-0107.

title: Client cannot book a viewing in another client's name
request: POST /api/viewings { clientId: <another client>, status: "ATTENDED" } with a CLIENT token
expected: 403, or clientId forced to the caller
actual: 201 – viewing created for clientId=another client with status ATTENDED.

title: Sign-in endpoints are rate-limited
expected: HTTP 429 once 60 requests/15 min is exceeded
actual: 429 returned on request #53 (earlier sign-ins in this run count toward the 60).
